question: How uncertain are R160 L1 model-minus-baseline precision and process recall differences under shared time blocks?
estimands: mature-alert success ratio and evaluable-event hit ratio, exact R160 pooled ratios within each year; unknowns remain outside precision denominator
population: frozen R160 selections and event outcomes, 2025/2026 separately
blocks: 21 exchange sessions anchored first CSI_ALL session per year, truncated at last R159 scored date in year; keep all calendar blocks including zero-count blocks; same sampled blocks for both methods; no reranking or refitting
invalid_draws: retain NaN if either denominator zero; record invalid count, suppress intervals if any invalid draw
comparisons: 2 years x3 frequencies x2 baselines x2 metrics =24; main cooldown versus F, others secondary
intervals: 95% and Bonferroni family24 percentile intervals (.05/48,1-.05/48); family does not adjust all EP35 history reuse
limitations: finite short-block descriptive uncertainty conditional on fixed fitted models and observed maturity; does not capture model estimation, selection research, future regimes or long dependence; no new adoption gate/window search
